triples.tail_surface: inside protected spaces and in CO2 cylinder rooms
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 受保护处所及CO2气瓶间内
triples.evidence_text: Threaded joints in CO2 systems are to be allowed only inside protected spaces and in CO2 cylinder rooms.

triples.tail_surface: thickness is to be measured to the bottom of the thread
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 测量至螺纹底部的壁厚
triples.evidence_text: For threaded pipes, where approved, the thickness is to be measured to the bottom of the thread.

triples.head_surface: internal surface of pipes outside of the engine room
triples.evidence_text: The internal surface of pipes outside of the engine room is to be galvanized.

triples.head_surface: openings which may admit air to, or allow gas to escape from a protected space
triples.head_canonical_zh: 可能导致空气进入或气体逸出受保护处所的开口
triples.tail_surface: capable of being closed from outside the protected space
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 能从受保护处所外部关闭
triples.evidence_text: openings which may admit air to, or allow gas to escape from a protected space, are to be capable of being closed from outside the protected space.

triples.head_surface: power ventilation serving the protected space
triples.head_canonical_zh: 服务于受保护处所的动力通风
triples.tail_surface: automatically shut down... prior to the discharge of the agent
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在灭火剂释放前自动关停
triples.evidence_text: A pressure switch or other device is to be provided to automatically shut down power ventilation serving the protected space prior to the discharge of the agent into the space.
